name: Kiora, the Crashing Wave
oracle_text:
+1: Until your next turn, prevent all damage that would be dealt to and dealt by target permanent an opponent controls.
−1: Draw a card. You may play an additional land this turn.
−5: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of your end step, create a 9/9 blue Kraken creature token."
blocked_sentences: +1: Until your next turn, prevent all damage that would be dealt to and dealt by target permanent an opponent controls.
−5: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of your end step, create a 9/9 blue Kraken creature token."

needs.what: a one-shot prevention effect that prevents all damage that would be dealt to a chosen permanent (here a targeted permanent an opponent controls) for a duration
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The prevent_damage op takes only `duration` and `player` and has no `objects`, so it cannot single out one permanent; the prevent_damage static applies only while a source permanent is on the battlefield

needs.what: a one-shot prevention effect that prevents all damage that would be dealt by a chosen permanent (the same target) for a duration, combat and noncombat
needs.why_existing_wont_do: prevent_damage has no source selector; there is no op that prevents damage dealt by a specific object

needs.what: the duration "until your next turn" (ends as the controller's next turn begins) on the two prevention effects above
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No op among those that could carry the prevention exposes an until-your-next-turn duration
